description: Android screen mirroring and control helper built on scrcpy and adb.

suggest.scrcpy: 投屏核心依赖，建议先 scoop install extras/scrcpy（自带 adb）

notes: pmirror            常规投屏（保持亮屏）
pmirror fast|max   低延迟 / 超清
pmirror wifi       一键无线投屏
pmirror devices    查看已连接设备
需要 scrcpy 与 adb：scoop install extras/scrcpy
